overview_description.description: Developer of AI-powered software for insurance carriers and MGAs designed to automate actuarial and underwriting workflows. The company's platform ingests and normalizes messy submission data, populates pricing models, and encodes expert decision-making into structured systems, enabling insurers to increase underwriting throughput without adding headcount. Its initial deployments focus on captive insurance and loss data ingestion, serving clients across the specialty and commercial insurance ecosystem.
